findings.title: payments runs a privileged container
findings.verification_evidence: Pod payments-6f7c-abcde in shop has container "app" with securityContext {"privileged":true}, and it also mounts hostPath /var/run/docker.sock.

findings.title: payments mounts the docker socket
findings.verification_evidence: Deployment shop/payments has volume "sock" with hostPath.path "/var/run/docker.sock", and container "app" also runs with securityContext.privileged: true.

findings.title: web container may run as root
findings.verification_evidence: Container web in pod web-5d8b-xyz12 has securityContext runAsNonRoot:true, runAsUser:1000, allowPrivilegeEscalation:false, so it can't run as root.

findings.title: worker uses a hostPath volume
findings.verification_evidence: Pod worker-77c9-qwert has only one volume, "scratch", which is type emptyDir with "hostPath":null, so the worker pod has no hostPath volume.

findings.title: node-agent DaemonSet uses host networking
findings.verification_evidence: The security context for the monitoring/node-agent DaemonSet template shows "hostNetwork":true.

findings.title: web has no CPU or memory limits
findings.verification_evidence: Deployment shop/web container "web" sets resources.limits cpu "200m" and memory "128Mi", so the finding that it has no limits is wrong.
